payload.core_mechanism_summary: Direct simulation: for each child not yet removed, reduce confidence of all later children by decaying cry volume, accumulating additional cry volumes from those who leave, using nested loops.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively processes all children in order, updating the state of later children in a nested loop. This is a brute-force simulation, not a bitmask enumeration, backtracking, branch-and-bound, graph search, or permutation enumeration. Among the given subtypes, none fit well, but search_bitmask_enumeration had the highest rule-based score and is selected for lack of a better match.
